description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual running race held on Easter Monday at Hallaryds School. The race is suitable for all ages with distances from 1.2 km for the youngest to 21 km as the main class. The courses mostly run on gravel roads and asphalt stretches through beautiful environments with winding stone walls, meadows, and forests in the borderland between Skåne and Småland. There are also shorter routes of 3.2 km, 6 km, and 9.8 km suitable for both running and walking. The event offers timing, water stations, prizes for the top finishers in each class, and a plaque for all who complete.
course_highlights: 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge from 1870 with four arches
The course runs through the borderland between Skåne and Småland with varied surfaces of asphalt and gravel roads
Several water stations and challenging ascents, including a hill with 25 meters of elevation over approximately 500 meters
additional: Number bibs are collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Changing rooms and showers are available in HIF's clubhouse for women and the school gymnasium for men. Timing is done with a barcode on the bib. Sports drinks and water are served at the water stations. Late registration can be made on the day of the race for an increased fee (50 SEK for adults, no increased fee for youth and walking classes). Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a plaque. The race also includes shorter children’s and walking routes, starting and ending at Hallaryds School. Participants can register via email or bank transfer. The event offers water stations and prize distribution after the race.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: The Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course runs two clockwise laps around the scenic Rocksjön and offers a wonderful running experience. The results from Varvetmilen are used for seeding in Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour in Sweden.
course_highlights: Two laps around Rocksjön clockwise
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Seeding for Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Number bib distribution and baggage storage take place on site in Knektaparken on race day. Simultaneously with Varvetmilen, the Minivarvet is held, a 210-meter race for children aged 0-6 years with medals for all participants. Registration for Minivarvet is on-site via Swish (80 SEK). The race starts in Knektaparken, runs two laps around Rocksjön, with number bib distribution the day before and on race day. Showers, changing rooms, luggage storage, and a simple café are available on site.

name: Vårruset
description: Spring Ruset in Halmstad is a recreational race for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or ambition level. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is part of a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and community.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Alet Nature Reserve and Skepparegatan in Halmstad
Measured 5 km course
Scenic area with the possibility to reach the event area on foot or by bike
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden days before the race. Picnic after finishing for teams of 5 people. Option to opt out of timing. Recommended age 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision), 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision). Changing clothes is recommended to be done at home as there are no changing facilities on site. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. Parking is available but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. Participants can choose to have their time recorded for the 5 km, and the event includes a festive atmosphere with opportunities for community and health.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition since 1989 and is an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to participate.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place May 3-5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's bib number. The event area opens at 17:30 with sponsor booths and activities. There is an option to leave outerwear and shower at the arena. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 years for 2.5 km (in adult company from 7 years) and 13 years for 5 km (in adult company from 11 years). Registration is binding and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before start. The event offers optional timing, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib. The race is both fitness- and team-friendly and held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

description: VårRuset in Vänersborg is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km on a certified course. The event is characterized by joy of movement and camaraderie and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. After crossing the finish line, teams consisting of five people are invited to a picnic, creating a wonderful spring evening together. The event starts and ends at Sanden in Vänersborg and offers a medal, finish bag, timing (optional), and bib number to all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Sanden, Vänersborg
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the race. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's bib number. The recommended age is 13 years for 5 km and 11 years for 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and free parking is available at Sanden. Teams consist of 5 people and everyone can run different distances. The event is part of Sweden's largest women's fitness series, focusing on community, joy of movement, and health. Participants can choose to have timing or run without, and there are officials, music, and entertainment along the course.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: 1600 kr långa banan, 1000 kr korta banan; efteranmälan 1900 kr och 1200 kr
description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on a spring-blooming Öland. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race is available in two variants: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs suitable for all levels. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service with officials, a commentator, and individual timing.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs between 2.7 km and 8.5 km, total 67.5 km
Short course: 6 legs between 2.7 km and 5.4 km, total 23.5 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Number bib pickup takes place on May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio hosts a group warm-up before the start. Officials are present on the course, at exchanges, as well as at the start and finish. Individual segment times, intermediate times, and team finish times are provided. The commentator follows the lead race from start to finish. Running on Öland, two course lengths, team categories, medals, grill plates, GPX files, changing/shower facilities, food/accommodation are offered.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and ends in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The race is flat and easy to run, with varying surfaces of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational runners and more experienced athletes. The focus is on community and running joy, and all teams start together at the same time. During the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also organized, with medals and diplomas for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat and easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Number bibs are collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing rooms are available in Sparbankshallen. Timing is done with a data chip, and both total finish time and split times for each runner are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken with a group warm-up at 10:20. After crossing the finish line, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink, and fruit. The race includes a mini-class for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to measure total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event offering a delightful six-kilometer course through Mjölby with start and finish in the City Park. The course runs along the Black River and features both challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments, with almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children's race, Bostadsbolaget Little City Run. All participants crossing the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organized by Norrköping Running Club in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cycling Club.
course_highlights: 6 km course with start and finish in City Park, Mjölby
Runs along the Black River for most of the route, 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments
additional: Number bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 with a 25% discount coupon. Warm-up led by Fitness4You before the start. All finishers receive a medal. The children's race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45 for ages up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until May 8 with an additional fee of 50 SEK. Massage services are available at the start and finish areas. The race takes place in City Park, with options for corporate tents, registration via the website, bib pickup at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual city race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race is held in Mariestad at the beginning of May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, children's race, and races for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional and well-attended running festival with great commitment from officials and participants.
course_highlights: Two main routes: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km in an urban environment
Children's race and disability race with shorter loops of 500 m and 2000 m
Part of Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Disability race at 10:30, Mini Mari at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in senior and veteran classes requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association. It is permitted to run together with a guide in the Disability Race. Courses are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances including 5 km, 10 km, as well as children's and disability races; registration required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm offering both half marathon and 10 km distances. The race takes place on flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for those aiming for a personal best. The event is a festival with start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in the scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a festival with flat courses suitable for personal bests. There is also a kids' race for children. Start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus traffic and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, kids' race for children up to 13 years old.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a delightful spring race that takes place along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic natural experience and a wonderful atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participation in exercise and community in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Running along Lake Hulingen
Fantastic natural environment
The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race is held at Knektavallen, Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. It is a family-friendly event focused on exercise and health. No specific information about price or registration fee is available on the website. The event includes a 10 km course and children's races, and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Registration details are available on the website.

name: Springtime 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 150 kr fram till den 31/12

description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a traditional running event with three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and HD's MiniSpringtime for children. The 10 km race is the classic and has been held since 1981, while the 5 km race is a shorter and more intense alternative. The races also offer team competitions where men and women compete on equal terms through time recalculations. The courses are carefully measured and start and finish are gathered at Stortorget, providing a nice and spectator-friendly running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in Helsingborg
The course includes the entire Pålsjöbacken uphill without detours
Measured 5 km and 10 km courses by Swedish Athletics course measurer
additional: The price includes bib number, medal, water, and fruit at the finish line. Late registration can be made until May 3 via the website with an additional fee, thereafter at Löplabbet subject to availability. Insurance options are available at registration. Team competitions are offered with time recalculations for men and women.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a cross-country race that welcomes all participants, from children and recreational runners to experienced runners and mountain bike cyclists. The race takes place in beautiful terrain along the pine-covered gravel ridge between Alberga and Kungsör, with trails and gravel roads offering moderate elevation changes and technical sections. The event is characterized by an open and welcoming atmosphere, created together by officials, spectators, and participants, and is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club. Many return year after year while new participants try for the first time.
course_highlights: Cross-country running and cycling along pine-covered gravel ridge
Trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday the week before the race. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club with a strong sense of community among participants, officials, and spectators.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km around the beautiful Växjösjön. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and focuses on promoting women's health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course around Växjösjön
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish line for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. The bib must be worn visibly throughout the race. There is an option to opt out of timing. The event area has water stations, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. Teams consist of 5 people and a picnic is granted to teams after crossing the finish line. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. The event also includes opportunities for HPV vaccination for women born between 1994 and 1999, which is offered free on-site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan – 1750 kr (2000kr fr.o.m. 28 april fram till och med 4:e maj)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 28 april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 28 april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km promenad – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 28 april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet – 100kr (upp till 12 år, förälder kan följa med som stöd men då utan anmälan )

description: Blood Run in Uddevalla is part of Sweden's largest sporting event aimed at raising awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Here, you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in teams. The race is open to everyone and concludes with a communal picnic, creating a social and friendly atmosphere. There is also a fun race for children, the Little Blood Run. Welcome to participate in this important and joyful event!
course_highlights: Start at the pedestrian crossing north of the Museum Park grassy area, with routes following Kungsgatan eastward
The 10 km course goes up Dynamitbacken and along the railway embankment by Bjursjön
The 5 km course reaches its highest point at Norrskolan and passes through Bleket
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3-5 participants). Team registration includes a picnic basket. There is a 40 SEK discount for blood donors. Late registration can be made on site at Museum Park from 4:00 PM on the day of the event. Payment can be made with wellness vouchers, Swish, email invoice, or e-invoice. The courses pass under the railway at Östra station and through the tunnel to Rimnersområdet. Organized in Uddevalla 2027, focusing on blood donation, health, and community. Participants can walk, jog, or run, and the event includes options for team registration and facilities such as changing rooms and parking.

name: BLK Trailen (Bredared)
location: Björkehovsgården, Bredared, Borås, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: BLK Trail in Bredared is a cross-country race organized by Borås Running Club. The race takes place on the blue trail at Björkehovsgården with an extension on the grass behind the farm where the start and finish are located. It is a welcoming competition suitable for runners who appreciate varied terrain and a scenic environment. Borås Running Club has an active program with several trails and events throughout the year, creating a great community for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country trail at Björkehovsgården
Start and finish on the grass behind the farm
Blue trail with varied running terrain
additional: Start and finish are located on the grass behind Björkehovsgården. The club has agreements for club clothing and subsidized training passes for members. Membership provides discounts on certain events. The club is insured through the Swedish Sports Confederation. The event focuses on offering a pleasant and varied trail experience for both experienced runners and amateurs, with local roots and community.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon race held in celebration of Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a 5-lap park road around Lake Hulingen, consisting of approximately 20% asphalt and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two water stations with water, sports drinks, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a gathering with food and socializing near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: 5-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt, the rest is park road
Two water stations with sports drinks, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance of Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. For runners expecting to take over 5 hours, the start time is 09:00. After the race, a gathering with food and socializing is offered around 14:30, approximately 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event to honor Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to participate in a private, but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Varvetmilen (Malmö)
location: Heleneholms IP, Malmö, Skåne County, Sweden
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med Heleneholms IF
description: Varvetmilen Malmö is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best mile. The race serves as a qualifying event for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group in the classic half marathon. The start and finish are at Heleneholms IP, and the course runs through scenic areas such as Nydalaparken and Almvik with a water station at 5 km. Varvetmilen is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with Heleneholms IF and also offers the Minivarvet for children during the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heleneholms IP
The course goes through Nydalaparken and Almvik
Water station at 5 km
additional: Minivarvet for children aged 0-6 years is held simultaneously on site with a 210-meter-long course. Registration for Minivarvet takes place on site and costs 80 SEK (Swish). Results from Varvetmilen are automatically used for seedings to Göteborgsvarvet 2026 without additional registration.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)

price_tiers.distance: 10 km Tävling (Junior, Senior, Veteran M/K35-60) Motion

description: The Start Mile is a recreational race in Örebro suitable for all runners and marks the start of the outdoor season for many. The race offers distances of 1 km for children, 5 km for youth and veterans, and 10 km for competitive classes, with the 10 km also serving as the district championship for Southern Svealand. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University, and the course runs on streets in the Almby district. All participants receive a medal, and there are prize ceremonies for different classes.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University
The course runs on streets in the Almby district
The 10 km class is the district championship (DM) for Southern Svealand and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from approximately 10:30 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at bib distribution and must be returned after finishing. Lost transponders are charged at 800 SEK. All classes except KnatteStarten have timing. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the start at Tybblelundshallen for an increased fee and subject to availability. Medals are awarded to all finishers. Prize ceremonies are held for the 5 km at 13:40 and the 10 km at 15:30.

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Spring Ruset Gothenburg is a popular spring race held in Slottsskogen with start and finish at Björngårdsvillan. The race offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course being officially measured. It is a social and inclusive event where participants can register individually or in teams, and teams that register are offered a picnic after the finish. The race is open to all ages, with a recommended age of 7 years in the company of an adult, and offers medals, finish bags, timing (optional), and bibs to participants.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course in Slottsskogen
Start and finish below Björngårdsvillan
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
additional: Registration is binding and can be done digitally until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Teams consist of 5 people, and all team members can run different distances. Teams that register are offered a picnic after the finish. The recommended age is 7 years in the company of an adult for the 2.5 km and 11 years in the company of an adult for the 5 km. The race is part of Sweden's largest women's fitness series, with digital registration, team participation options, and timing on the 5 km. Participants are offered medals, finish bags, a picnic, and entertainment.

name: Varvetmilen Göteborg
description: Varvetmilen Gothenburg is a qualifying 10 km race that gives participants the opportunity to be seeded into a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start is at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen, and the course passes through central Gothenburg, passing iconic locations in the city. The registration fee is 349 SEK until January 31 and 449 SEK from February 1. There is also a Digital Varvetmilen, a digital qualifying race held from April 18 to 26, allowing participants worldwide to compete and be seeded for Göteborgsvarvet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km course starting and finishing at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen
Qualifying result for seedings at Göteborgsvarvet 2026
Opportunity to participate digitally via Digitala Varvetmilen (April 18 - 26) for international participants
additional: 10 km course starting at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen; water station at 5 km; seeding rules mean that the result automatically qualifies for a better start group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026; registration via the website; start confirmation sent via email; bib number pickup according to schedule at Friidrottens Hus and Stadium Run Nordstan. The Varvetmilen starts at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen and has seeding rules that automatically assign a better start group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start times are between 11:00 and 11:20, and the start confirmation with detailed start group information is delivered approximately two weeks before the race; a mini race for children (210 m) can be registered on-site for 80 SEK (Swish).

name: Hässleholmsloppet
location: Hovdala slott, Hässleholm, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km, and 5.4 km, with the 21 km included in Spring i Skånes Trailcup 2026. The courses feature soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings, where the longest route has extra elevation gain and the shorter distances offer an easier technical course with equally beautiful natural scenery. The race welcomes both recreational runners and youth, with a recommendation that younger participants run in adult company on the longest distance.
course_highlights: Soft, winding trails in varied forest environments
Views of water crossings along the course
The 21 km route starts with parts of the 10 km course and has extra elevation gain
additional: Start times: 5.4 km at 11:40, 10 km at 11:50, 21 km at 12:00. Maximum 400 participants. Bibs are collected on site no later than 30 minutes before the start and must be worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing. Water stations with water and sports drinks are available on all courses. No showers or changing facilities, toilets available. Name changes can be made via the website for a fee of 100 SEK. Trail running, registration via the website, maximum 400 participants, water stations, no showers or changing facilities.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Stockholm featuring races for all ages, including Mini-race for the youngest children, the Little Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class up to grade 6, a 5 km timed race for participants aged 13 and older, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The race is organized by Löparakademin, a non-profit organization working with youth in immigrant neighborhoods for personal development through running. Throughout the day, there will be music and entertainment with DJs along the course, and all participants will receive a medal at the finish line. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging running experience that promotes movement and equal health.
course_highlights: 5 km timed race for ages 13 and up
Little Skärholmsloppet approximately 1.6 km for children in preschool to grade 6
Mini-race of 500 meters for children 0-6 years, with the opportunity to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplan. Start times: Mini-race at 10:30, Little Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different start groups by age, Fun Run 1.6 km starting at 12:25, 5 km race starting at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and energy at the finish. Registration is free and can be done until May 14 at 17:00, with late registration possible at bib distribution and on race day if spots are available. Music and DJs along the course for extra motivation. The race takes place at Puckelbollplan in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants will receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC 200 miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Tyresö, with start and turnaround at Alby Friluftsgård. The course is a 11.5 km loop offering hilly terrain, technical trails, and beautiful views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten. The race is part of the Tyresö Extreme Challenge, which offers several distances including Backyard Ultra, MiniUltra 46 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles. It is a race that combines tough challenges with a wonderful community and positive energy among runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop with start and finish at Alby Friluftsgård
Hilly gravel roads and technical trails with roots and stones
Spectacular views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten
additional: Start and turnaround are at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö. The course is marked with orange reflective ribbons spaced 20-70 meters apart. Runners pass a tent with a buffet and volunteers at the turnaround, but are advised not to stay too long. The race takes place all weekend with multiple distances, and the start time for 200 miles is at 10:00 on race day. The event is held in mid-April and may require endurance in difficult weather conditions, including icy or cold conditions early in the season.

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
location: Krogsereds, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom (upp till 14 år): 50 kr

description: Krogsereds Trail Run is a scenic trail run organized by Krogsereds Idrottsklubb that offers a fantastic running experience with distances suitable for all ages. The race takes place around the beautiful hiking trails near Lyngsjön and features categories from children to the main race of 10 km. It is a family-friendly event with start times spread out in the morning and prizes drawn among participants.
course_highlights: Scenic hiking trails around Lyngsjön
Multiple distances suitable for children, youth, and adults
The race offers varied terrain in a forest environment
additional: Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Recreation 10:30, Main race 10:30. There are no shower facilities on site. Prizes are drawn among participants. Recommended to arrive at least 30 minutes before start. Trail in natural terrain around Lyngsjön, registration via Google Forms, no shower facilities, the race is scheduled between 09:00 and 14:00 on April 24, 2027.

name: Premiärloppet
location: Skatås Motionscentral, Göteborg, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: The premiere race is a running event organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott and held at Skatås Motionscentral in Gothenburg. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, both courses offering gently hilly terrain with gravel surfaces and sections of trail. At 6 km, there is a water station, and at the finish line, water and sports drinks are served. All participants receive a medal, and nice prizes are awarded from Löplabbet.
course_highlights: 10 km: gently hilly on gravel surface
5 km: gently hilly with Brudaremossen and partly trail downhill
Water at 6 km and at the finish
additional: Number bibs can be picked up on race day between 10:00 and 13:15 at the start/finish in Skatås. Changing rooms are available for women and men near the race area. Results are published on saik.nu and sent to Friidrottsstatistik. Medals are awarded to all participants. The race offers medals to all participants and prizes from Löplabbet. Number bib distribution occurs both in advance and on race day, and water is available during the race.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organized by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops, and through scenic Småland nature. Participants will experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical and hilly trails. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a picturesque environment with good atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Winding trails through Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocks
Passage through forest tunnel and muddy holes
additional: Changes to the distance are possible until April 10 via email. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run) with lap at 11:45. Bib number must be clearly visible. Recommended equipment is trail running shoes and mobile phone. In case of interruption, contact volunteers or the phone number from the bib distribution. Transportation is arranged from water stations if needed.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
location: Stensö/First Camp Stensö, Kalmar, Kalmar Municipality, Sweden
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6,706-meter loop starting at 10:00 AM. The race follows the original format where each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the next start occurs at each full hour. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. The distance of 6,706 meters is chosen because 24 laps equal 100 miles, a dream goal for many ultrarunners, but everyone is welcome regardless of ambition level.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter loop
Start every full hour, race continues until one runner remains
24 laps equal 100 miles (161 km)
additional: The race is a Backyard Ultra in the original format. Runners who do not complete a lap within one hour must end the competition. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. All levels are welcome. Registration as a volunteer requires login.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
location: Strandvägen to Sollentunavallen, Sollentuna, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best mile in Sollentuna. The course runs through the town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km. The final part of the course is beautifully situated along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade before finishing at Sollentunavallen. The results from Varvetmilen are seedings for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sollentuna town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen
Water station at 5 km
The final part of the course runs along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade
additional: Start and finish area at Sollentunavallen and Strandvägen near the water. Bib number distribution and baggage drop-off take place on site on race day. The mini race for children 0-6 years old is held simultaneously with a 210-meter race, registration on site (80 SEK via Swish). The race is an important seed race for Göteborgsvarvet and offers facilities such as bib number pickup and baggage drop-off.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a trail running adventure that takes you into exciting nature and new experiences. The race offers a fairy-tale run through beech forests, past small lakes, and historic sites such as Bexell's Talking Stones. After the run, a locally produced picnic awaits as a conclusion. The event is open to different pace groups and encourages carpooling for participants.
course_highlights: Running through beech forests in Kinnekulle
Passing small cozy lakes and Bexell's Talking Stones
Ends with a picnic at a locally produced farm
additional: Gathering takes place at 10:00 AM at Öströö Fårfarm. The distance is approximately 15-17 km with 2-3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. Recommended carpooling and assistance with coordination are offered. The event is designed to provide a communal and nature-close running experience with a focus on nature, views, and local food.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Spring Ruset in Stockholm is a recreational race for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in Norra Djurgården. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, with team registrants receiving a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen near Stockholm University
The race takes place on gravel and forest trails in a scenic environment
additional: Number bibs are sent by mail upon registration before April 17, otherwise they can be picked up on site. Teams of five people receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available at cost. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike, or public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden's largest sports tour for girls and focuses on community and health.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350 kr till 2000 kr, gratis för de första 250 i Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blood Run Kristianstad is a recreational race offering a scenic course through the Water Realm, with varying surfaces of grass, gravel, and asphalt. The race features distances of 5 km and 10 km that extend westward from Tivoli Park, crossing the Helge River and further into the beautiful natural area. For younger participants, there is Little Blood Run with shorter courses inside Tivoli Park, adapted for children aged 0-12 years. Blood Run is a social and healthy activity that also highlights the importance of blood donation and concludes with a communal picnic.
course_highlights: Scenic course through the Water Realm
Varying surfaces: grass, gravel, and asphalt
Little Blood Run for children 0-12 years inside Tivoli Park
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (up to 5 participants per team). Team members can participate in different distances. The last day to register a team is May 12. Late registration can be done on-site at Tivoli Park from 4:00 PM on the race day. Course lengths for Little Blood Run are 100 m (ages 1-3), 550 m (ages 4-7), and 1100 m (ages 8-12). The surface for the 5 km and 10 km varies between grass, gravel, and asphalt. There are changing facilities and toilets at the event area. Blood Run concludes with a communal picnic. The event includes a blood donor gift, activities on-site, the opportunity to participate in teams (up to 5 people), and various distances to suit all participants. The race is part of Sweden's largest blood donation and fitness campaign.

name: Blodomloppet
location: Västra Marks IP, Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sweden
organizer: Blodcentralerna i Blekinge och KA 2 IF

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blood Race in Karlskrona is a fitness event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog, or run over distances of 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in the children's race over 800 meters or in a special walking class over 5 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a communal picnic for all participants. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, with designated routes for walkers to enable a joint finish. Blood Race is one of Sweden's largest health initiatives and attracts many participants each year.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses of 5 km and 10 km for running
Separate route for walkers over 5 km
Children's race over 800 meters
additional: The race offers individual and team registrations (up to 5 people per team). Team participants can compete in different distances. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members (40 SEK per person). Large registrations can be managed via an Excel template and customer portal in the registration system. Walkers are released first on their own route to facilitate a joint picnic after the race. There are changing facilities, toilets, water stations, medical services, and options for free transportation to and from the event. The race is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association. Participants can run on-site or participate remotely between May 17 and September 7, 2027. The starter kit includes a shirt, medal, and bib number. The event offers discounts for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race with start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping where teams of four participants each run an exciting four-kilometer stretch. The race offers a great team spirit with men's, women's, and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course is close to the competition center with motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish. It is an evening filled with exercise, community, and joy, where children and youth can participate for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on an exciting course near the competition center
Motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish
additional: Helhetshälsan offers leg massages both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes are awarded to the first team in each class, and nice prizes are raffled among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides energy-rich products after the finish. The race is held in Folkparken, with the possibility of late registration on site, and participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-rich products after the race.

name: Stafettvarvet
price_range: 1399 kr per lag (tidigare pris), senare pris 1699 kr från 2026-02-01
course_highlights: 3.2 kilometer fast track around Slottsskogen
Start, exchange, and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
Course through the new entrance park with cheering support from teammates
additional: Each team consists of four runners, all running the same course. The relay baton is handed over over the exchange zone marked by zones based on start numbers. Included in the registration is a picnic basket from Carotte that teammates can enjoy after crossing the finish line. Companies can register multiple teams and pay via invoice. There is an option to book a tent spot in the Relay Race company's area in the entrance park to gather and cheer the team before, during, and after the race. The start is based on a buddy seeding where fast runners line up at the front. The team comprises 4 participants, each running 3.2 km. Registration is via the website, starting at 18:00, with start groups and options for corporate bookings and picnics. The event is outdoors and focuses on community and corporate activities.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a recreational run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km through central Västerås with start and finish at Lögastrand. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. Registration can be done individually or as a team, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is part of a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for exercise and socializing.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport in the Livli shopping center Erikslund in the days before the race. There is supervised baggage drop-off, water stations, and toilets at the event area. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's number bib. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Training sessions are organized in several locations before the race. Participants receive a number bib, finish bag, and medal; teams of 5 people; open to runners, joggers, and walkers; registration via the web; the event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: The Blood Race in Linköping is one of Sweden's largest sporting events focused on raising awareness of the vital need for blood donation. The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers and is open to both individual participants and teams. During the event, the blood bus will be on site for those who wish to become blood donors, and the race has a strong local connection with ambassadors and collaborations. It is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a communal picnic and contributes to youth activities through the proceeds.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood bus
The race is organized for the twenty-second time with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five team members born in 2009 or later) participate at half the registration fee if registered by April 30. Teams can be expanded to five participants at no cost until April 30. Participants registering by May 14 will receive free public transport within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day via SMS ticket. Late registration is possible at the bib distribution days before the race. Payment can be made via Swish, card, or e-invoice for companies. The race includes various distances for adults and children, with options to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. The event is a large community celebration with music and social gathering.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
description: Welcome to the premiere of Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan on April 21, 2026! The race is designed for you to run fast over 10 km. The course is measured and runs on fast bike paths around Stallbacka in Trollhättan. It is a loop of 3.3 km that is run three times with start and finish next to the tennis hall. Several pacers from 35 to 60 minutes are available to help runners at different paces.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km course
Fast bike paths around Stallbacka
Loop of 3.3 km run three times
additional: Gathering takes place at 17:00 at Bäckelyckepark. Late registration can be made via RaceID up to half an hour before the start without an increased fee. Bibs are collected near the start and finish. A test run is organized on March 25, 2026 at 18:00 with gathering at the tennis hall. There is an opportunity to register for the Digital Varvetmilen for seeding for the Gothenburg Half Marathon, but registration is done separately at goteborgsvarvet.se.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging trail race of 5 km with 300 meters of elevation gain in beautiful and technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course offers nice trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The start is at the old football field, and the race includes steep climbs, singletrack, and scenic views over Ågelsjön. Welcome to participate in this somewhat classic race that provides a real challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 meters of elevation in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep climbs
Beautiful view over Ågelsjön and passage by Eremiten's Jakob's Cave
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class as well as raffle prizes. A ballpark is located 200 meters from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are offered as add-ons. The course's technical sections include "Koklämman" with a rope for assistance uphill, and the race passes a cozy barbecue area under a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk, course description includes climbs and trail sections.

name: Värmlandsstafetten

price_tiers.label: tier_1
price_tiers.description: Pinnen kostar 500:- och ni får er logotyp på pinnen.

price_tiers.label: tier_2
price_tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift fram till och med 27/4 1 500:-/lag.

price_tiers.label: tier_3
price_tiers.description: Efteranmälan Sker 29/4 på plats på arenan/växlingsområdet. Kostnad 2 000:- plus stafettpinne 750:- vid start första gången.

description: Värmlandsstafetten in Karlstad is a two-hour relay race where teams of 5 to 15 participants pass a baton around Sundstatjärn on a flat lap course approximately 1,270 to 1,300 meters long. The race starts at 6:00 PM with the goal of transporting the baton to the finish within two hours at the arena in Karlstad, with start and finish at the arena. Teams decide how many laps each person runs and switch after each lap; in the first year, a logo relay baton is purchased that follows the team each year. Register your team and participate in a social, health-promoting evening that contributes to community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Flat lap course around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 - 1,300 meters per lap
Team competition for 5 - 15 participants with switching after each lap and two hours at the arena
Start and finish at the arena; option to order a logo relay baton that follows the team
additional: The course around Sundstatjärn is approximately 1,270 meters per lap (just under 1,300 meters), asphalt surface. Tents and parking are available at the arena/Sundstabadet. Start/finish at the arena; two hours to transport the baton to the finish. The course runs around Sundstatjärn in Karlstad, with each lap measuring about 1,270 meters. Each team consists of at least 5 and at most 15 participants, with the start at 6:00 PM and two hours to complete the relay and transport the baton.

name: Skrylleloppet
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Björnstorps IF invites you to the 54th Skrylle Race on April 25, 2026. The races are offered in 3, 5, and 10 km, with a new recreational class for men and women at 3 km. The courses run on Skryllegården's exercise trails through varied forest terrain and have gravel surfaces. Here is practical information about registration, bib numbers, parking, and race day.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km on Skryllegården's loop courses
Varied forest terrain with recreational trails
Surface: gravel
additional: Online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; Early bird until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until April 25. On race day, registration is possible on-site with the option to change name or category for a fee of 100 SEK; only Swish payments are accepted on-site. Bib numbers are sent via email during race week and can also be collected at Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race from 10 am to 6 pm (20% discount at pickup). Results for the 10 km can be used for seeding in the TCS Lidingöloppet. Participants cycling to the event can register this at bib pickup for a chance to win prizes. Online registration is open until the start; Early Bird prices until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until race start. On race day, registration is available on-site with Swish payment. Bib numbers are sent via email or can be picked up at Löplabbet in Lund. There is baggage check.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar organized by Högby IF on April 25, 2026. The race offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge), as well as youth categories from 600 meters to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby environment with gravel and park paths, as well as a short asphalt section, and fluids are available at the turnaround and finish. Medals are awarded to all finishers, and registration is conducted according to the schedule provided by the organizer.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and forest paths with a short asphalt section
additional: Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge; start times are according to the schedule, and late registration is possible as per the organizer. The routes for 4 km and 8 km are standard (1 and 2 laps over the bridge). Presence on site is required for certain volunteer registrations according to RF standards. Bib numbers can be picked up at Skälby lodge on Friday, April 24, from 15:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at bib pickup no later than 1 hour before the start. Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish; medals are awarded to all who complete the race.

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to running experiences at Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in Billingens recreational area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 meters of elevation gain. It takes you around the northern part of Billingen with beautiful trails along the mountain edge. As a runner, you will experience a varied terrain such as deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows, coniferous forest, and in several places, stunning views of the landscape. The surface varies from easy to run on, with about 6 km of asphalt and some more demanding sections.

The medium course, 21 km, runs on the northern part of Billingeleden and reaches about 500 meters above sea level. This course goes on mixed trails, meadowland, and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, measures just over 200 meters of elevation gain and runs on trails of varying difficulty and shorter sections of road.

Information about courses and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, at 10:00 at the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
21 km, at 10:45 at Björnasäter, Lerdala. Buses depart from Billingens Fritidsområde at 10:05.
12 km, at 11:30 at the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
All finish lines are at the stadium.
course_highlights: 47 km across the entire northern Billingen - just over 47 km and approximately 930 meters of elevation gain
Varied terrain: deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadowland, coniferous forest, and sections with asphalt (about 6 km)
12 km follows Blue Trollstigen (just over 200 hm); 21 km runs on the northern Billingeleden (about 500 hm) and participants are bused from the stadium
additional: Start/finish for the 47 km at Billingens fritidsområde (Stadium). 21 km starts in Björnasäter, Lerdala (about 12 km from the stadium) and participants are bused out - the bus is included in the registration fee and departs from the southern end of the stadium (visible from the secretariat and finish line), around 10:05 after the 47 km start. Course markings: orange pennants and arrows as well as Billingeleden's orange marking ("B") for 47/21 km; 12 km follows Trollstigen's blue markings. The surface varies from easy to more technical sections; there are also shorter asphalt sections (~6 km). Videos and photos from previous years are linked on the page. Start times: 47 km at 10:00; 21 km at 10:45; 12 km at 11:30. Bus to the start for 21 km around 10:05. Parking is available at the large parking lot; changing/shower facilities at Billingecentret.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 AM and has a maximum time of three hours, with start and finish areas at Biskopsudden. The course runs around Southern Djurgården and passes through scenic natural areas near central Stockholm. The event is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, while also welcoming all who want to experience springtime in a beautiful city environment. Registration is available at different price levels (495-745 SEK), and bib and start information are shared in advance; water stations and medical personnel are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
Mixed surface with asphalt, gravel, and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as start information. Water stations and medical personnel are available along the course. The maximum time is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single lap of 21.1 km around Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and sports drinks from Enervit are offered along the course.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests - the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown every year since its start in 2019. The competition offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (possible one lap) and 10 km (two laps) with the finish inside the Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizer emphasizes speed, joy, and a friendly event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (resulting in 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have achieved personal records and several course records are documented
additional: Number bib distribution takes place inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally subject to availability until 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens sports field (Badhusvägen); commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about 850 meters walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100 - 900 meters; Badhusvägen will be closed during the race day. There is clothing drop-off (instructions to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Sports drinks (Umara) and water are available at the turn-around for the 5 km race. A team competition for the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic environment by Landsjön in Kaxholmen outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages - 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults/youths as well as several children's classes including Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake with start and finish at Vistavallen, and musicians and water stations along the course contribute to the atmosphere. The event encourages both individual registration and team competitions for four participants.
course_highlights: Road race in a scenic environment around Landsjön, start/finish at Vistavallen
Distances 12.5 km and 5.5 km along the lake; the course is run clockwise so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking at Vistavallen is available (recommendation to use public transport or park at Hunnerydsbadet); team competitions consist of four people all running the same distance and total time is recorded, teams receive a bag from Rudenstams Gårdsbutik; in case of a course record on 12.5 km, 5,000 SEK is awarded to the runner's club; payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22 and no automatic confirmation is sent - you are registered if you receive a six-digit number and have paid; IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20 (the website also mentions April 19); registration closes on April 25 at 17:00 but registration on race day can be done at least one hour before if space permits. Registration closes April 25 at 17:00. Payment is via Swish. IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20; specify IK Vista as club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is possible with combined finish/result.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a historic race for all ages, with a children's race in the morning and an adult race at 12:30 PM. There are two classes to choose from, 6 and 12 kilometers, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it's not completely flat...), starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan, which offers perhaps the most magnificent starting line in the race world. In between, runners will experience running through Bromma's streets, where the feeling is like running through gardens in apple blossom. This experience is enhanced by many neighbors coming out to cheer or even setting up their own small water stations or sprinklers — each refreshing in their own way. Among other things, this has given rise to the race's slogan: Stockholm's most charming running race.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organizing for the 53rd time an evening race during Hörby market with three different distances:

Market Race 12.6 km: competition class starts at 18:30, recreational class starts at 18:40

Bil-Månsson Race 6.1 km: all start at 18:50.

CAN-CAN Race 3.4 km: all start at 19:00.

The race starts and ends within Hörby town center, with large parts run in forest environment.
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, trails. See maps.

Don't miss this opportunity!
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu - right up until the race begins.

Late registration can be done at the Lågehallen entrance (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Directions from Riksväg 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information regarding preparations, registration, course, and directions can be found at: 
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is this year's most generous race, where running joy meets beautiful nature in Djurgården. With a course that winds along gravel and asphalt roads, the race offers a delightful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 registered participants receive a specially designed t-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, there is a relaxing After Run with grilling and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. Additionally, part of the registration fee goes to Sweden for UNHCR, making every step meaningful – both for you and someone in need.

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
FK Friskus-Varberg invites you to a running race on Saturday, October 18, starting and finishing at Friskusstugan.

Along the course, you pass through large parts of Varberg. You run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget with a magnificent view of the sea. The course also goes through several parks/urban forests, including the beautiful Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen. In addition to the half marathon, there is also a course of 11.5 km.

All info and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se

images.alt_text: Man springer längs en kuststig med havet i bakgrunden under Varberg Halvmarathon.
Deltagare i Varberg Halvmarathon startar loppet bland höstfärger.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Athletics invites everyone from elite athletes to cheerful recreational runners and children to participate in a winter race on our streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Challenging ice, slush, wonderful winter crispness, or a fast asphalt course awaits those who participate and watch.
The New Year's Race is a pleasant occasion to be a little active before the New Year's feast and to sum up the year. And as some say; "What you do on New Year's Eve, you will do the rest of the year"! So take the opportunity to be active, bring a friend, and run or jog around the course.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and will take place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, starting in Olshammar. On the race page, there are maps, elevation profile, and a GPX file available for download to plan your run. Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the club's page. Welcome to participate and access course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map Part 1 and Map Part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available for download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the page. Course information includes Map Part 1 and Part 2 as well as elevation profile. GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available for download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shores of Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2 - 5 runners with relay points at any location along the course. SI-pins are recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at Laxå OK's clubhouse.

description: Lidingöloppet Spring Mile is a spring race of 5 and 10 kilometers with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is called one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile routes and runs through winding forest roads, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, mostly on soft trails and sometimes hilly. The race serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable for those wanting to check their fitness or secure a better starting group. Before and after the race, coffee and light food are available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km 127 m elevation, 5 km 52 m elevation)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; course marked with red/white ribbons and km flags
additional: Number bib distribution from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on-site for a higher fee. Free baggage drop-off is available; baggage storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers, and sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Kids' Spring Run for younger participants; water station at 5 km and water supplies at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: Retrovarvet 2026
description: Retrovarvet is a running event held on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Heden in Gothenburg. The gathering is at 07:45, and the event runs approximately from 07:45 to 09:00. Registration is open to club members and is done via the provided email; more information is available on the club's website and Facebook event.
course_highlights: Start and gathering at Heden in Gothenburg
Approximately 10 km (Trailvarvet test) to prepare for the Varvet race
Part of Gothenburg Half Marathon's spring training program focusing on warm-up and community
additional: Registration is only open to club members; the page indicates registration via email (premiarbanan1980@gmail.com) and that members should log in to the club's website. Gathering at Heden at 07:45. A Facebook event is linked from the event page. Contact details for the club's office are available on the contact page. Gathering at 07:45 at Heden; April 25, 2026; registration requires login and is for club members. Retrovarvet serves as a warm-up for the Gothenburg Half Marathon and is connected to spring training sessions and race preparation.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km lap course with 400 meters of elevation gain. Total distance over five laps is 50 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain. Technical trail on single track and animal trails in dramatic forest! Welcome
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with approximately 400 m climb per loop (50 km / approximately 2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love to run ourselves and forms the foundation of the entire trail weekend. A perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat, and tears reminiscent of spectacular races in our Swedish mountains as well as in the Alps of Europe. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long delightful downhill sections, and stunning views. In between, you enjoy winding trail running through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 offers at least 500 meters of elevation gain and is perfect for those training for mountain marathons and similar races.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg 500 started, Jättestigen was a big topic of discussion. A few years later, it was closed due to landslide risk. In 2025, Jättestigen will be revived under a new name - Jättetrappan...

Isaberg 500 is a part of Outnorth trailtour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail run with varied trails and hills, technical character reminiscent of mountain and alpine races
Multisport around Isabergstoppen: paddling, MTB, and trail running - categories for Solo and Duo
Isaberg Gravel: lap course approximately 45 km with start/finish in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to 50 years 3 laps, older/sporty 2 laps, recreational 1 lap
additional: Contact via GI: mobile +46 703 815 118 and email gimulti@gmail.com. Organizers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Opportunity to book guided cycling groups; organizers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group's needs. Main distance approximately 10.5 km (Trail Tour distance); Kids Trail approximately 2 km with about 150 meters of elevation gain; start time Sunday 12:00; location Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact niklas@isabergtrail.se.

name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a historic race in the heart of Ängelholm. Here, participants will experience the city, sea, and forest over the same mile. The 5 km race initially offers a lovely park run in the cozy Hembygdsparken. After approximately 2.7 km, the course crosses the Rönne River, continuing along the beautiful promenade in Nybroskogen. Finally, the course turns back over the river, where a sprint awaits before the finish line at Tullakrok. Our 10 km course has the same start as the 5 km, but turns north after about a kilometer. Here, runners are treated to scenic views of Skälderviken and its harbor, with Kullaberg in the background. After approximately 7.7 km, the courses merge again, and runners can enjoy the beautiful river walk in Nybroskogen.

description:
The New Year's Run is a perfect way to get active during the holiday season. Start and bib number distribution are centered around Brobacken / Bagges Square, and the organizer emphasizes good service with water stations, medical services, and changing and shower facilities close to the race area. A welcoming message on the page encourages registration via the partner EQ Timing and to register early for a lower entry fee.

additional: Start for all courses takes place at Brobacken near the competition center at Bagges Square. Bibs can be collected on Friday evening (specified 17:00 - 20:00) at the municipal building on Bagges Square or on the morning of the race from 09:30; race confirmation will also be sent via SMS/email (for example, Friday 2/5 at 12:00 for late registrations). Changing and shower facilities are available in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset near the race center (bib must be shown at the reception). Approximately 55 marshals/route guards, bike marshals, and sweepers are used along the course. Water stations: Vattenpalatset (~2.5 km / 800 m for the 1.6 km course), Laggarns road (after ~5 km for the 10 km), and water immediately after the finish. Medical tents are located at the race center, and course officials carry first aid equipment. Lerumsloppet is a family-friendly community event with several distances for children and adults, with start lists and information available on government platforms and the official website.
